leadText: A League Staff (Japanese: リーグスタッフ League Staff) is a type of Pokémon Trainer introduced in Generation VIII. They are Macro Cosmos employees whose job is to help s during the Galarian Gym Challenge. There is only one battleable League Staff member outside of the Galar .

==In the manga==
 ]]
===Pokémon Adventures===
A male League Staff appeared in Ooh Shiny!! Legendary Equipment, welcoming Henry and Casey to the Motostoke Stadium.

In Teary!! The Voice of the Master, a male and female League Staff apprehended Bede in Stow-on-Side.

In Shocking!! Reunion in the Forest, a male and female League Staff accompanied Melony, where they waited until she made her leave before calling Gordie.

In Stealth!! Infiltrate the Energy Plant, multiple League Staff were seen guarding the Energy Plant entrance, where they attempted to dissuade Leon from entering. They were however blown away by Bede's .
 

==In the TCG==
 
 
League Staff was introduced as a in the Pokémon Trading Card Game during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by Emi Ando. It allows the player to draw two cards, then draw another two if is in play.
